text: Arundel Avenue is a residential street with one-way southbound traffic. I have heard from residents of Arundel Avenue about serious traffic safety concerns that threaten pedestrian safety and they contacted me to request enhanced safety measures in their community. My office has polled the street and 89% of residents support this installation. In order to improve resident and pedestrian safety, the installation of an all-way stop at this intersection is being requested.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Arundel Avenue and Ainsworth Road.
